notes.title: Update Status
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Sadly the update will not be released at the end of March (today), BUT it's actually coming along very great.

To clarify, I'm Claudio, the main programmer and game designer of the game. I'm currently the only one from the team working on the project in my free time. In the past year, I got married, moved to a different country (Spain), started studying for my Master's Degree in AI, and a new job in AI Research.

It turns out the game code and project were a disaster (the whole game itself grew from a very quickly made prototype with triangles), so I had to pretty much move everything to a new project, and I'm making the most of it by creating a good base for future projects. It's currently working very well, it's much more optimized and I'm tweaking some gameplay elements. For example, I'm trying out:

- Punches use stamina too, so you can run out of stamina and become vulnerable
- Dashes have invincibility frames
- Alternate control scheme with L1/L2 for left jab/hook and likewise with R1/R2. You can charge hooks.

I'm also using the game as a framework for some of my AI research. I'm working on implementing Deep Reinforcement Learning for the bird AI for a class assignment, so that will be interesting. This means that I'm trying to use machine learning to make an AI brain for the birds.

If anyone has any ideas for the game, this would be a great time to share them.

Finally, I'm hoping to start releasing some videos/content about working on the game and following projects, in case anyone is interested.

Cheers,
Claudio

TL;DR
No update today, but it's coming great and I'll be working on the game in the following months.

notes.title: Upcoming Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're currently working on a big update that deals with all the issues of the current version of the game.

We're reworking the input system to include full controller support.
We're reworking the localization to avoid [BIRD SOUND] errors.
We're reworking the UI to avoid multiple issues.

And lastly, we're working on a new Bird AI trained by Machine Learning algorithms.

In short, a much better version of the game is coming soon.

Projected release: end of March 2022

notes.title: Bird Boxing - Contest #1
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome Contenders[/h1]

We are happy to announce the first Bird Boxing contest!

The game is still under development and will be released in February 2021, but during the upcoming months, we will be sharing some info about the fighters, game modes, and other surprises about the game.

Some of these surprises will be contests such as this one!

[h2]Contest rules[/h2]

For this contest, all you need to do is:

[olist]
[*] Download the latest demo of the game from the [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1_UXb4ImdIYcN26G3BVuwuXDEK7y6tiId?usp=sharing]following link[/url]
[*] Play and complete the Arcade Mode
[*] Take a picture of your score and share it with us in one of the following ways: Instagram/Twitter with the hashtag #BirdBoxing or in the #sky-championship channel of our Discord
[/olist]

You can join our Discord community with the following link:
https://discord.gg/3JtCv9V

[h2]Prizes[/h2]
The winner of the contest will be one who reaches the highest score while the contest is active.

[list]
[*] A personalized wallpaper with your chosen bird and your name
[*] Your name in the credits in the "Past Champions" section.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38649999/d4a1a2241f5e38361d0aa3067e84198ed6ae8cbe.gif[/img]

We hope you can participate and make history!
